title: Not All Countries Celebrate Thanksgiving: On the Cultural Dominance in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models in 11 different languages for lists of concrete cultural objects (e.g., public holidays, songs, books, movies) and calculating an 'In-Culture Score' based on how many generated items align with the culture of the queried language rather than the dominant English culture.

Administering multilingual public opinion surveys (World Values Survey and Political Coordinates Test) to the models to evaluate abstract cultural values, and computing the Euclidean distance between the model's outputs and language-specific human reference distributions.
